# Questions before answers · S11

Classify question cards as facts, causes, values or designs; drag to change lens or select for exploration. Branch to expand/invert with explicit ancestry. A separate development phase holds provisional answers, evidence, approaches and the decision an answer could change. Unselected and unanswered questions remain available. Answer status is the user's judgment, not an automated truth check. Local workspaces, grouped Undo, recovery, export/import via creative-kit. Limits: 28 questions, 6 selected, 100 workspaces. Tests cover ancestry, preservation, Undo and invalid references.

This standalone version is retained for earlier work. Its methods now live in Reframing, which can copy local Questions workspaces or import their JSON exports without changing this route’s data.
